On the installed-dependency hash: bun.lock already pins the @hyperframes/engine tarball by sha512 integrity and CI installs with --frozen-lockfile, so a byte-different same-version install is already foreclosed by a tracked file. This hash is defence in depth against an install that bypasses the lockfile, not the primary binding.
